## Product, consulting or both?

A platform is useful when a team wants direct access to a deployable modelling workflow. Bespoke consulting is better suited to unusual data, specialist methods, independent model review or a question that does not fit a standard workflow. The two can also work together, with SIMBA providing the platform and JTP supporting the decisions, assumptions and capability around it.
